The Fabraix Playground focuses on security for AI agents through two main areas: automated red-teaming and real-time guardrails. In the Playground, each week, a live AI agent is presented with a persona, tools, and a secret to protect. Participants attempt to extract that secret using various techniques like prompt injection and social engineering.

Successful completions in the challenge are determined by the community's ability to find and submit effective methods to "break" the agent's defenses. Players can sign in, submit their findings for review, and compete on a leaderboard, with the player achieving the most approved breaks each week winning a cash prize.

For more detailed information, you can visit [Fabraix's official site](https://fabraix.com).
